title: Isolate operator Approve/Reject Flex buttons strictly away from customer LINE groups
context_summary: Human approval workflows notify both the customer chat and the operator.
observation: Sending the same approval Flex Card to a customer LINE group exposed operator Approve/Reject actions and internal account IDs.
verified_action: Enforce audience='customer' vs audience='operator' in buildApprovalFlexCard and block secret patterns from entering any learning or report store.
